$comment: R2 (RESTRUCTURE.md §8 R2): the engineering line on a product's code (src/engine/engineering.mjs). Started by the owner on one owner-approved issue the CTO has assigned (backlog/dev-queue.json), behind the spend confirmation. A TESTER fail or a REVIEWER / SECURITY revise sends the job back to DEVELOPER with the findings, at most reworkMax times in all, then the job blocks; a CTO revise sends the spec back to TECH-LEAD at most specReworkMax times. A refuse ends the job rejected (no merge request). The job ends in the Owner's office as a git.merge request; the engine never pushes.
label: Engineering

estimateUsd.note: the plan's estimate, not a measurement (RESTRUCTURE.md §8 R2, R0.3 models, before thinking tokens; a large spec adds the CTO's review, about USD 0.16): one pass about USD 1.36; with one rework about USD 2.14; a rework alone 2.14 - 1.36 = USD 0.78 (DEVELOPER about 0.50, TESTER 0.01, REVIEWER 0.14, SECURITY 0.13). The job cap is the limit.
